description: Repositions or resizes a background image (canvas graphic) in a live Trident document. Use open_document to get the canvas graphic ID and current dimensions — it appears as: image <id> "<url>" at (x, y) width:W height:H. The position at (x, y) is the TOP-LEFT corner. USE THIS BEFORE placing many geographically-positioned nodes: if the background map is small (e.g. width < 700), scale it up so nodes have room to breathe and do not overlap. Requires a valid editor access token.

action_explanation.description: Optional: brief explanation shown live to human collaborators (max 250 chars).

canvasGraphicId.description: ID of the canvas graphic to update (from open_document output).

changes.description: Geometry fields to update. Only provided fields are changed; all others are preserved.

aspectLock.description: Lock aspect ratio on resize (default true).

height.description: New height in canvas units. Increase this to scale the map up.

width.description: New width in canvas units. Increase this to scale the map up.

x.description: New top-left X position in canvas units.

y.description: New top-left Y position in canvas units.

token.description: Editor access token for this document.

userName.description: First name of the human you are assisting.

name: update_canvas_graphic
